title_as_printed: Experimental data and correlation of water activities of KCl solutions by molar vapor pressure depression

footnotes_as_printed.table: aw = (p/p0); S. D. = +/- 0.15% (printed below the 150 C block)

property_description: water activity aw = p/p0 (ratio of solution vapour pressure to pure-water vapour pressure at the same T), from differential isoteniscope measurement; corrected for water-vapour non-ideality and for water evaporated in the isoteniscope
pressure_note: not applicable; vapour pressure itself is not tabulated, only aw = p/p0

composition.note: molality column header printed only as 'm'; unit mol/kg inferred from the paper's symbol list ('m molality of the solution'); concentration corrected by authors for water evaporated in the isoteniscope

skip_rows.reason: temperature block label rows (also carried by group_rows)

extra_unmapped: (aw)calc. (value calculated from the authors' correlation k = a + b mu^1/2; not measured)

notes: Four temperature blocks printed side by side, stacked here with one label row per block (e.g. '75 C'), label rows are carried by group_rows (T.constant).
